# RFP ACT SACT 26-02C

Request for Proposal (RFP) for Contractor Support to Headquarter Supreme Allied Commander Transformation for Capability Development Management Support ( **CDMS**), HQ SACT, Norfolk, Virginia, U.S.A.

**Type of Contract**: Firm Fixed Price (FFP), Level of Effort.

**Period of Performance**: Award – 31 Dec 2026 with the possibility of four 12- month option periods (2027-2030). Period of Performance will be determined per labour category based on expected duration of the requirement.

**Bid closing date:** Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office, **no later than ~~01 15~~ 22 Sep 2026, 0900 hours**, Eastern Time, Norfolk, Virginia, USA. No bids shall be accepted after this date and time. No hard copy proposals will be accepted.

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 26-02 Part C Amendment #6**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/rfp026002c_amdt6.pdf)
